desc:
⭐Well it's schooltime and we're stuck in the worst school ever, Mr. Cranky's school. He tries to chase the students who escape his classroom, and his whole school is haunted and out to get you. So it's time to escape, with 21 stages to beat, can you ESCAPE Mr. Cranky's School? 🏫

⭐ Make sure to Join the Mega Obbies group for more fun and awesome obbies!  

⭐ Please leave a like and favorite for this obby, it took a while to make so I hope you have fun playing.
